Seasonal Effects for the Umbrawells
Seasons Without Storm
Untouched from the wind and brutal sun above, for eons the land beneath the soil had lay sterile and unchanged, until life found a new 
way to flourish. As the acidophilic ecosystem grew, so did the rhythms of seasons begin to affect what was once frozen in time. Bacteria 
and fungus blooms wax and wane, subterranean creatures scuttle in their migrations, and seasons of feast and famine dictate the life 
beneath the earth, just as above.
Like a dark mirror, the Umbrawells react to the land above them: The Undermoor tunnels flood with the dark silt from the Beggar's 
Moor, many of its tunnels awash with the rich run off that feeds countless blind algivores. The vast vaults of the Splitspine mountains 
react to the altitude of the sky outside its stone walls, frost collects in the crevices, leading to runnels of fresh water that feeds the 
unseen black rivers below. No land is untouched by change, and the Umbrawells, now more than ever before, react to change.

Suffocating Stagnation • Oxygen is thin within the 
cramped confines. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, for 
every hour for any creatures not native to the Umbrawells. 
Failure: Suffer one level of Exhaustion.
Clean Air • Calm environment with no effects.
Unseen Bounty • ±1 to the Range Result on a Fishing 
Expedition.
Burning Water • The sulfuric ecosystem of the 
Umbrawells is particularly saturated. Any creatures not 
native to the Umbrawells take 1 Acid damage per minute 
while submerged in water.
Vibrant Molds • Soft light suffuses the caverns from the 
many molds that cling to the walls. Many areas in the 
Umbrawells that are usually obscured in Darkness are 
instead in Dim Light.
Deafening Depths • Shriekshroom spread across the 
caverns, loudly reacting to any that near. Shriekshroom 
Natural-Traps will be encountered more frequently.
Veins of Blue • Azacrid Ore shines brightly in the 
darkened tunnels. Any Foraging Expeditions will yield 
double the result for Azacrid Ore.

Iron Harvest • Slick yellowed liquid drips from the ceiling 
above, the sulfur rich smell leading Travelers to feel that 
they are stepping into the bowels of hell. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the result for Infernoil.

Creeping Intelligence • Slime molds spread across the 
floors, ingeniously growing towards the remains of beasts. 
±1 to the Range Result on Hunting Expeditions.
Caustic Dangers • Burning dollops of acrid mold drip for 
inverted fungal pillars above. Pilth Cluster Natural-Traps 
will be encountered more frequently. 
A Living Pulse • A bloom of molds overtakes the ceilings 
and walls and pulses in hypnotic flashes. Any creatures not 
native to the Umbrawells have Disadvantage on ranged 
attack rolls.
Lethal Reproduction • Dangerous projectiles fly out, 
bounding off stone and bludgeoning unfortunate creatures 
from the blooming mushrooms. Clammuster Natural-
Traps will be encountered more frequently.
Fog of the Forgotten • Each footfall near the white globules 
of slime mold raises clouds of spores, fogging the mind. 
Alzabrath Natural-Traps will be encountered more 
frequently.

Guiding Light • With an influx of wintering creatures to 
spread its pollen, the glowing stalk-like plants lights the 
way for many of these venturing beasts. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the result for Lanternull.
Morning Dew • Globules of slime resting on small stalks 
shine with a healthy light, surrounding by industrious little 
dewmites. Any Foraging Expeditions will yield double the 
result for Dewmite Spire.
Spry Steps • An orange cloud of mold spores float 
through the air, invigorating those that breathe it in with 
an unbounding energy. Any creatures not native to the 
Umbrawells, add 10 ft. to their movement speed.
Winter
Gaseous Air • Natural gases suffuse the air. All Fire 
damage rolls add +3 damage. Constitution Saving Throw: 
DC 14, for every hour for any creatures not native to the 
Umbrawells. Failure: Suffer one level of Exhaustion.
Blind Darkness • Billowing spores of dustmote mold float 
within the cramped tunnels, irritating the eyes of any 
that step through. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 8, any 
creature not native to the Umbrawells. Failure: Creature 
has the Blinded condition for 1 minute.
Shifting Earth • The height of the summer heat causes 
tremors under the earth as stone expands with the 
shifting temperature. At the Keepers discretion, tunnels 
can cave in blocking passes, or stalactites can fall from 
the tremors. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, any creature 
below an unstable stalactite. Failure: Target creature takes 
7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage from the falling stone.
Oppressive Mold • A black fungal mat settles onto the 
cave walls, stifling the air with a heavy feeling of gloom. 
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature not native to 
the Umbrawells. Failure: Creature has Disadvantage on all 
Charisma tests for 1 hour.
Drifting Dust • Fungal spores cover the stone floors, 
leaving visible track marks. Any Tracking, Wisdom 
(Survival) checks are made with Advantage.
Dripping Deluge • Groundwater leaking from above drips 
from the ceiling. Dexterity (Acrobatics) Saving Throw: DC 12, 
any Traveler attempting a Dash action. Failure: They slip 
on the slick surface and have the Prone condition.
Hungering Youth
Tormull feast voraciously 
during the spring months to 
feed their young. Creatures 
have Disadvantage against the 
tormull's Involuntary Death 
Reaction.
Curious Generation
Newly born gorr pups 
explore their subterranean 
environment, and the parents 
are on high alert. Double any 
gorr found on the Expedition 
Hunt Tables and they gain 
Advantage to Wisdom 
(Perception) checks.
Rising Waters 
Esslinter flourish with rising 
tide of the spring floods. Double 
any esslinter found on the 
Expedition Hunt and Scavenger 
Tables and they gain Advantage 
to Initiative rolls. 
Drying Depths
Icullus find it difficult to 
navigate the drier caverns as 
the water table lowers. Re-roll 
the first Scavenger or Hunting 
Expeditions rolls if it results in 
an Icullus
Migrating Mollusks
Mollucite take advantage of 
the arid season to navigate 
the dry ceilings. Mollucite 
gain Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks. 
Blooming Vaults
Fungus flourish in the warm 
summer months, bolstering 
the mollock population. 
Double any mollock found on 
the Expedition Hunt Tables 
and double the results found 
when Scavenging their Guano 
component.
Preparing to Harvest
Readying for the incoming 
influx of creatures seeking 
warmth from the colder season, 
acrynn infest the tunnels nearer 
the surface to claim hunting 
grounds. Double any acrynn 
found on the Expedition Hunt 
Tables and they gain Advantage 
to Advantage to Wisdom 
(Perception) checks.
Hungering for Flesh
As bacterial mats dry up in 
the dwindling underground 
streams, skith turn to more 
carnivorous diets. Skith attacks 
now score a Critical hit on a 19 
or a 20.
Spent Parenthood
By fall, many adult tormull 
collapse, leaving dry husks in 
their caverns after seasons of 
caring for their brood. Re-
roll the first of any Hunting 
Expeditions that result in a 
tormull.
Seeking Warmth
The colder caverns only further 
focuses the krainis heat vision 
to hunt. Krainis gain Advantage 
to Wisdom (Tracking) checks 
and Initiative rolls.
Hostile Haven
Scavengers from all over shelter 
within the Umbrawells during 
the colder seasons. Double 
any creature result from the 
Scavenger Table.
Welcomed Invaders
Skittering within its lair, 
the taurachni greets all new 
creatures to its web-lined 
lair hungrily. Taurachni gain 
Advantage in Dexterity Saving 
Throws. They can use the Stone 
Fall Lair Action during this 
season.
